name: plugin.google_adk_web_bridge
description: Google ADK Web UI bridge: Angular visualization status, execution DAG export (A2UI / ngx-vflow format), and dev server manager.

entrypoints.name: adk_web_status
entrypoints.description: Inspect ADK web dashboard build artifacts, Angular configurations, and dependencies

parameters.name: project_dir
parameters.description: Path to cloned adk-web directory or custom dashboard root

entrypoints.name: adk_web_export_graph
entrypoints.description: Convert Harness agent execution DAG into A2UI / ngx-vflow interactive node graph JSON

parameters.name: nodes
parameters.description: List of node objects with 'id', 'label', 'type', and optional 'status'

parameters.name: edges
parameters.description: List of edge connections with 'source' and 'target' IDs

entrypoints.name: adk_web_start_dev_server
entrypoints.description: Generate configuration command and launch specification for ADK Web UI dev server

parameters.name: port
parameters.description: Local HTTP port to bind the dashboard

parameters.name: poll_interval
parameters.description: File watcher polling interval in milliseconds
